reason: The free pilot takes away the money risk, but not the risk to my time, my board's time and 950 members' patience if we switch and it falls over. And nothing here earns me more per member or per guest; it runs what we already run. I'd wait until Zwolle is live and I can call their board.
objection: Two founders and an AI-built product. Twelve months' notice and a spreadsheet export are fine on paper, but if they stop, I'm the one who has to migrate 950 members again in the middle of the season. And I don't see where the extra green fee, buggy, lesson or bar revenue comes from.
would_change_my_mind: A comparable 18-hole club that has been live for a full season, whose board tells me on the phone that it runs without problems and shows me more guest bookings or bar revenue through the app.
